summary: Practise QGIS overlays, Sentinel-2 NDVI and environmental data checks. Explore the five-day training outline and course outcomes.
lede: Geospatial analysis for environmental assessment helps GIS analysts, assessment specialists and project planners check and interpret spatial evidence for environmental decisions. The course covers source-layer quality checks, QGIS vector overlays, Sentinel-2 NDVI, and terrain and catchment analysis. It also develops skills in documenting spatial uncertainty and preparing maps and evidence notes that explain data limitations; image classification and automation are covered conceptually.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already handle spatial information and need to use it more reliably in environmental screening, baseline analysis or project review.
modules: QGIS Map Packages and Decision Reporting
prerequisites: Intermediate GIS experience is expected, including working with map layers, coordinate reference systems and basic geoprocessing. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with QGIS installed; the course uses sample environmental datasets and does not require a separate software account.
